question.text: 'Series NAV' of a Cat III AIF is computed as:

answer.text: Series Assets − Series Liabilities − Series Expenses divided by number of units in that Series

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.3, Series NAV = (Series Assets − Series Liabilities − Series Expenses) / Units in Series. The Trap: Other formulas don't capture class-specific fee differentiation. Cross-Exam Context: Important for investors receiving differential rights (Class A/B/etc.). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Always obtain the series-level NAV when evaluating performance of a specific investor class.
